panels.description: Global Chainlink BTC/USD 60-second TWAP path for only the active five-minute Polymarket window, with the first boundary TWAP shown as Price to Beat. The bounded current-market path is resent every second so a refreshed browser reconstructs the elapsed window and the completed market is replaced at rollover. This panel is independent of trading-process and PnL filters.
panels.title: BTC 5-Minute Realtime Market

panels.description: Lifecycle health derived only from durable trading process state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE p.enabled
      AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping')
      AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
      AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at,p.started_at,p.created_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes'
  ) AS "Active Processes",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE p.enabled
      AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping')
      AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
      AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at,p.started_at,p.created_at)<now()-interval '2 minutes'
  ) AS "Stale Active Processes",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE p.status='failed' AND p.updated_at>=now()-interval '24 hours'
  ) AS "Failures 24h"
FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
  AND p.status <> 'completed';

panels.title: Realtime Process Health

panels.description: One bar per filled, officially resolved entry for the selected process. Direction is labeled UP or DOWN; confidence is always shown as a positive probability. PnL uses recognized manual-exit proceeds and exit timing when present, otherwise official settlement economics.

targets.rawSql:
WITH resolved_decisions AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.decision_at,d.decision_id,d.process_id,d.outcome AS forecast_outcome,d.fair_probability,
         m.official_outcome,m.official_winning_token_id,o.order_id,o.market_id,o.token_id
  FROM polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions d
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id=d.market_id
  JOIN polymarket.orders o ON o.process_id=d.process_id
   AND (o.client_order_id=COALESCE(d.metadata#>>'{paper_order_plan,orders,0,request,client_order_id}',d.metadata#>>'{order_plan,orders,0,request,client_order_id}')::uuid
     OR o.raw_payload#>>'{request,metadata,decision_id}'=d.decision_id::text)
  WHERE d.process_id=(${process_id:sqlstring})::uuid AND d.execution_mode IN ('paper','live') AND d.action='buy'
    AND d.outcome IN ('up','down') AND d.fair_probability BETWEEN 0 AND 1
    AND d.decision_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND m.official_outcome IN ('up','down') AND m.official_winning_token_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM polymarket.fills f WHERE f.order_id=o.order_id AND f.process_id=o.process_id
      AND f.source IN ('paper','live') LIMIT 1)
  ORDER BY d.decision_at DESC LIMIT 20
), filled_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.process_id,d.order_id,d.market_id,d.token_id,d.decision_at,d.decision_id,d.forecast_outcome,
         d.fair_probability,d.official_outcome,d.official_winning_token_id,SUM(f.size)::numeric AS filled_size,
         SUM(f.price*f.size)::numeric AS entry_cost,SUM(f.fee)::numeric AS entry_fees,BOOL_AND(f.source='live') AS is_live
  FROM resolved_decisions d JOIN polymarket.fills f
    ON f.order_id=d.order_id AND f.process_id=d.process_id AND f.source IN ('paper','live')
  GROUP BY d.process_id,d.order_id,d.market_id,d.token_id,d.decision_at,d.decision_id,d.forecast_outcome,
           d.fair_probability,d.official_outcome,d.official_winning_token_id
), recognized_exits AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.process_id,e.order_id,x.timestamp_utc AS realized_at,x.price AS exit_price,x.size AS exit_size,
         (x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,net_proceeds}')::numeric AS net_proceeds
  FROM filled_orders e JOIN polymarket.account_trades x ON x.linked_order_id=e.order_id AND x.token_id=e.token_id
  WHERE e.is_live AND x.side='sell' AND x.applied_exit_size=x.size AND x.applied_exit_size=e.filled_size
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,kind}'='manual_live_full_exit'
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,process_id}'=e.process_id::text
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,order_id}'=e.order_id
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,net_proceeds}'~'^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
), presentation AS (
  SELECT e.*,COALESCE(x.net_proceeds-e.entry_cost-e.entry_fees,
    CASE WHEN e.token_id=e.official_winning_token_id THEN e.filled_size ELSE 0::numeric END-e.entry_cost-e.entry_fees) AS net_pnl
  FROM filled_orders e LEFT JOIN recognized_exits x USING(process_id,order_id)
)
SELECT CASE WHEN forecast_outcome=official_outcome THEN '✅ ' ELSE '❌ ' END||
       CASE WHEN forecast_outcome='up' THEN 'UP ' ELSE 'DOWN ' END||
       to_char(decision_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','MM-DD HH24:MI')||' UTC - '||
       CASE WHEN net_pnl>0 THEN '+'||chr(36)||to_char(net_pnl,'FM999999990.00')
            WHEN net_pnl<0 THEN '-'||chr(36)||to_char(abs(net_pnl),'FM999999990.00')
            ELSE chr(36)||'0.00' END AS "Decision",
       fair_probability::double precision AS "Forecast confidence"
FROM presentation ORDER BY decision_at DESC;

Grafana Live updates this panel every second independently of the dashboard's global refresh timer. Waiting indicates no active process, market discovery, or disagreement between process feeds.

panels.description: Current trading-entry enablement. Paper processes use their canonical execution.execute_signals configuration and active lifecycle. Live processes additionally require their latest durable manual-entry state to be enabled. Selected process displays Enabled or Disabled. All processes displays only the enabled-process fraction.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eligible_processes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.process_id,p.enabled,p.status,p.config#>>'{execution,mode}' AS execution_mode,
         COALESCE((p.config#>>'{execution,execute_signals}')::boolean,false) AS execute_signals
  FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
  WHERE (${pnl_scope:sqlstring}='All processes' OR p.process_id=(${process_id:sqlstring})::uuid)
    AND p.process_type='btc_5m'
    AND p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
    AND p.status<>'completed'
), entry_state AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.process_id,
         p.enabled
         AND p.status='running'
         AND p.execute_signals
         AND (
           p.execution_mode='paper'
           OR (
             p.execution_mode='live'
             AND latest.event_type='btc_live_entries_enabled'
             AND COALESCE((latest.metadata->>'entries_enabled')::boolean,false)
           )
         ) AS entries_enabled
  FROM eligible_processes p
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT e.event_type,e.metadata
    FROM polymarket.trading_process_events e
    WHERE e.process_id=p.process_id
      AND e.event_type IN (
        'btc_live_entries_enabled','btc_live_entries_disabled',
        'btc_runtime_starting','btc_runtime_started',
        'btc_runtime_resuming','btc_runtime_resumed',
        'btc_runtime_suspended','btc_runtime_stopping',
        'btc_runtime_stopped','btc_runtime_stop_failed'
      )
    ORDER BY e.timestamp_utc DESC,e.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) latest ON true
), summary AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE entries_enabled)::bigint AS enabled_count,
         COUNT(*)::bigint AS total_count,
         COALESCE(bool_or(entries_enabled),false) AS selected_enabled
  FROM entry_state
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN total_count=0 THEN 'N/A'
  WHEN ${pnl_scope:sqlstring}='All processes'
    THEN enabled_count::text||'/'||total_count::text
  WHEN selected_enabled THEN 'Enabled'
  ELSE 'Disabled'
END AS "Name",
CASE
  WHEN total_count=0 THEN -1::double precision
  WHEN ${pnl_scope:sqlstring}='All processes'
    THEN enabled_count::double precision/total_count::double precision
  WHEN selected_enabled THEN 1::double precision
  ELSE 0::double precision
END AS "Value"
FROM summary;

panels.title: Trading Entry Status

panels.description: Cumulative lifetime net realized PnL for the current PnL scope. Recognized manual live exits use actual net proceeds and exit time; other filled entries use official settlement economics.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS from_ts,$__timeTo()::timestamptz AS to_ts
), buckets AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT generate_series(date_bin('5 minutes',from_ts,timestamptz '1970-01-01'),to_ts,interval '5 minutes') AS time FROM bounds
  UNION SELECT to_ts FROM bounds
), selected_process AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.process_id,p.name,p.created_at FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
  WHERE (${pnl_scope:sqlstring}='All processes' OR p.process_id=(${process_id:sqlstring})::uuid)
    AND p.process_type='btc_5m' AND p.process_scope='realtime_paper' AND p.status<>'completed'
), filled_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT o.process_id,o.order_id,o.market_id,o.token_id,SUM(f.size)::numeric AS filled_size,
         SUM(f.price*f.size)::numeric AS entry_cost,SUM(f.fee)::numeric AS entry_fees,MAX(f.timestamp_utc) AS filled_at,
         BOOL_AND(f.source='live') AS is_live
  FROM selected_process p JOIN polymarket.orders o USING(process_id)
  JOIN polymarket.fills f ON f.order_id=o.order_id AND f.process_id=o.process_id AND f.source IN ('paper','live')
  WHERE o.side='buy'
  GROUP BY o.process_id,o.order_id,o.market_id,o.token_id
), recognized_exits AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.process_id,e.order_id,x.timestamp_utc AS realized_at,x.price AS exit_price,x.size AS exit_size,
         (x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,net_proceeds}')::numeric AS net_proceeds
  FROM filled_orders e JOIN polymarket.account_trades x ON x.linked_order_id=e.order_id AND x.token_id=e.token_id
  WHERE e.is_live AND x.side='sell' AND x.applied_exit_size=x.size AND x.applied_exit_size=e.filled_size
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,kind}'='manual_live_full_exit'
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,process_id}'=e.process_id::text
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,order_id}'=e.order_id
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,net_proceeds}'~'^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
), realized AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.process_id,e.order_id,x.realized_at,(x.net_proceeds-e.entry_cost-e.entry_fees)::numeric AS net_pnl
  FROM filled_orders e JOIN recognized_exits x USING(process_id,order_id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.process_id,e.order_id,m.official_resolution_received_at,
    (CASE WHEN e.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN e.filled_size ELSE 0::numeric END-e.entry_cost-e.entry_fees)::numeric
  FROM filled_orders e JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id=e.market_id
  WHERE m.official_outcome IN ('up','down') AND m.official_winning_token_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NOT NULL AND m.official_resolution_received_at<=(SELECT to_ts FROM bounds)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recognized_exits x WHERE x.process_id=e.process_id AND x.order_id=e.order_id)
)
SELECT b.time,p.name||' ['||left(p.process_id::text,8)||']' AS metric,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.net_pnl) FILTER(WHERE r.realized_at<=b.time),0)::double precision AS value
FROM selected_process p JOIN buckets b ON b.time>=p.created_at
LEFT JOIN realized r ON r.process_id=p.process_id AND r.realized_at<=b.time
GROUP BY b.time,p.process_id,p.name ORDER BY b.time,metric;

panels.title: Cumulative Net Realized PnL by Process

panels.description: Aggregate fresh unrealized PnL for current scheduled-market entries that remain open. Fully recognized manual exits are excluded. When entries exist but no bid is fresh within two seconds, PnL displays No fresh mark instead of $0.

targets.rawSql:
WITH clock AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT now() AS at), selected_process AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.process_id,p.name,p.created_at FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
  WHERE (${pnl_scope:sqlstring}='All processes' OR p.process_id=(${process_id:sqlstring})::uuid)
    AND p.process_type='btc_5m' AND p.process_scope='realtime_paper' AND p.status<>'completed'
), filled_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT o.process_id,o.order_id,o.market_id,o.token_id,SUM(f.size)::numeric AS filled_size,
         SUM(f.price*f.size)::numeric AS entry_cost,SUM(f.fee)::numeric AS entry_fees,MAX(f.timestamp_utc) AS filled_at,
         BOOL_AND(f.source='live') AS is_live
  FROM selected_process p JOIN polymarket.orders o USING(process_id)
  JOIN polymarket.fills f ON f.order_id=o.order_id AND f.process_id=o.process_id AND f.source IN ('paper','live')
  WHERE o.side='buy'
  GROUP BY o.process_id,o.order_id,o.market_id,o.token_id
), recognized_exits AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.process_id,e.order_id,x.timestamp_utc AS realized_at,x.price AS exit_price,x.size AS exit_size,
         (x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,net_proceeds}')::numeric AS net_proceeds
  FROM filled_orders e JOIN polymarket.account_trades x ON x.linked_order_id=e.order_id AND x.token_id=e.token_id
  WHERE e.is_live AND x.side='sell' AND x.applied_exit_size=x.size AND x.applied_exit_size=e.filled_size
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,kind}'='manual_live_full_exit'
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,process_id}'=e.process_id::text
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,order_id}'=e.order_id
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,net_proceeds}'~'^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
),
current_entries AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.* FROM filled_orders e JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id=e.market_id CROSS JOIN clock c
  WHERE m.window_start<=c.at AND m.window_end>c.at AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recognized_exits x WHERE x.process_id=e.process_id AND x.order_id=e.order_id)
), marked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.*,mark.best_bid FROM current_entries e CROSS JOIN clock c
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT checkpoint.best_bid FROM polymarket.orderbook_checkpoints checkpoint
    WHERE checkpoint.token_id=e.token_id AND checkpoint.integrity_status='ok' AND checkpoint.best_bid IS NOT NULL
      AND checkpoint.source_timestamp BETWEEN c.at-interval '2 seconds' AND c.at+interval '1 second'
      AND checkpoint.received_at BETWEEN c.at-interval '2 seconds' AND c.at
    ORDER BY checkpoint.source_timestamp DESC,checkpoint.received_at DESC,checkpoint.ingest_sequence DESC LIMIT 1
  ) mark ON true
)
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0::numeric WHEN COUNT(best_bid)=0 THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE SUM(filled_size*best_bid-entry_cost-entry_fees) FILTER(WHERE best_bid IS NOT NULL) END::double precision
         AS "Current Fresh Unrealized PnL",COUNT(*) AS "Current Market Entry Orders" FROM marked;

), recognized_exits AS MATERIALIZED (

         (x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,net_proceeds}')::numeric AS net_proceeds
  FROM filled_orders e JOIN polymarket.account_trades x ON x.linked_order_id=e.order_id AND x.token_id=e.token_id
  WHERE e.is_live AND x.side='sell' AND x.applied_exit_size=x.size AND x.applied_exit_size=e.filled_size
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,kind}'='manual_live_full_exit'

  SELECT e.process_id,e.order_id,x.realized_at,(x.net_proceeds-e.entry_cost-e.entry_fees)::numeric AS net_pnl

panels.description: PnL, runtime, and settlement status for the current PnL scope. Fully recognized manual exits are realized at their actual proceeds and exit time, excluded from current exposure, and not counted as awaiting official settlement.

matcher.options: /^(Current Market Entries|Freshly Priced Current Entries|Unpriced Current Entries|Awaiting Official Settlement)$/

targets.rawSql:
WITH clock AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT now() AS at), selected_process AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.process_id,p.name,p.status,p.enabled,p.config,p.created_at,p.updated_at,p.heartbeat_at,p.stopped_at
  FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
  WHERE (${pnl_scope:sqlstring}='All processes' OR p.process_id=(${process_id:sqlstring})::uuid)
    AND p.process_type='btc_5m' AND p.process_scope='realtime_paper' AND p.status<>'completed'
), filled_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT o.process_id,o.order_id,o.market_id,o.token_id,SUM(f.size)::numeric AS filled_size,
         SUM(f.price*f.size)::numeric AS entry_cost,SUM(f.fee)::numeric AS entry_fees,MAX(f.timestamp_utc) AS filled_at,
         BOOL_AND(f.source='live') AS is_live
  FROM selected_process p JOIN polymarket.orders o USING(process_id)
  JOIN polymarket.fills f ON f.order_id=o.order_id AND f.process_id=o.process_id AND f.source IN ('paper','live')
  WHERE o.side='buy'
  GROUP BY o.process_id,o.order_id,o.market_id,o.token_id
), recognized_exits AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.process_id,e.order_id,x.timestamp_utc AS realized_at,x.price AS exit_price,x.size AS exit_size,
         (x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,net_proceeds}')::numeric AS net_proceeds
  FROM filled_orders e JOIN polymarket.account_trades x ON x.linked_order_id=e.order_id AND x.token_id=e.token_id
  WHERE e.is_live AND x.side='sell' AND x.applied_exit_size=x.size AND x.applied_exit_size=e.filled_size
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,kind}'='manual_live_full_exit'
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,process_id}'=e.process_id::text
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,order_id}'=e.order_id
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,net_proceeds}'~'^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
), fill_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT process_id,COUNT(*) AS filled_orders,SUM(entry_cost)::numeric AS entry_notional,
         SUM(entry_fees)::numeric AS entry_fees,MAX(filled_at) AS last_fill_at
  FROM filled_orders GROUP BY process_id
), realized_positions AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.process_id,e.order_id,x.realized_at,(x.exit_price*x.exit_size-e.entry_cost)::numeric AS gross_pnl,
         (e.entry_fees+(x.exit_price*x.exit_size-x.net_proceeds))::numeric AS realized_fees,
         (x.net_proceeds-e.entry_cost-e.entry_fees)::numeric AS net_pnl
  FROM filled_orders e JOIN recognized_exits x USING(process_id,order_id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.process_id,e.order_id,m.official_resolution_received_at,
         (CASE WHEN e.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN e.filled_size ELSE 0::numeric END-e.entry_cost)::numeric,
         e.entry_fees,
         (CASE WHEN e.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN e.filled_size ELSE 0::numeric END-e.entry_cost-e.entry_fees)::numeric
  FROM filled_orders e JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id=e.market_id
  WHERE m.official_outcome IN ('up','down') AND m.official_winning_token_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recognized_exits x WHERE x.process_id=e.process_id AND x.order_id=e.order_id)
), resolved_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT process_id,COUNT(*) AS resolved_positions,SUM(gross_pnl)::numeric AS gross_realized_pnl,
         SUM(realized_fees)::numeric AS realized_fees,SUM(net_pnl)::numeric AS realized_pnl,MAX(realized_at) AS last_realized_at
  FROM realized_positions GROUP BY process_id
), unresolved_entries AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.*,m.window_start,m.window_end FROM filled_orders e JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id=e.market_id
  WHERE m.official_resolution_received_at IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recognized_exits x WHERE x.process_id=e.process_id AND x.order_id=e.order_id)
), current_entries AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT u.* FROM unresolved_entries u CROSS JOIN clock c WHERE u.window_start<=c.at AND u.window_end>c.at
), pending_settlements AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT u.process_id,COUNT(*) AS awaiting_official_settlement,MIN(u.window_end) AS oldest_pending_settlement_at
  FROM unresolved_entries u CROSS JOIN clock c WHERE u.window_end<=c.at GROUP BY u.process_id
), marked_current AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.*,mark.best_bid,mark.source_timestamp AS mark_at FROM current_entries e CROSS JOIN clock c
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT checkpoint.best_bid,checkpoint.source_timestamp FROM polymarket.orderbook_checkpoints checkpoint
    WHERE checkpoint.token_id=e.token_id AND checkpoint.integrity_status='ok' AND checkpoint.best_bid IS NOT NULL
      AND checkpoint.source_timestamp BETWEEN c.at-interval '2 seconds' AND c.at+interval '1 second'
      AND checkpoint.received_at BETWEEN c.at-interval '2 seconds' AND c.at
    ORDER BY checkpoint.source_timestamp DESC,checkpoint.received_at DESC,checkpoint.ingest_sequence DESC LIMIT 1
  ) mark ON true
), current_pnl AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT process_id,COUNT(*) AS current_market_entries,COUNT(best_bid) AS current_freshly_priced,
         COUNT(*)-COUNT(best_bid) AS current_unpriced_entries,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0::numeric WHEN COUNT(best_bid)=0 THEN NULL::numeric
              ELSE SUM(filled_size*best_bid-entry_cost-entry_fees) FILTER(WHERE best_bid IS NOT NULL) END::numeric AS current_fresh_unrealized_pnl,
         MAX(mark_at) AS latest_mark_at FROM marked_current GROUP BY process_id
), metrics AS (
  SELECT p.*,COALESCE(f.filled_orders,0) AS filled_orders,COALESCE(r.resolved_positions,0) AS resolved_positions,
         COALESCE(x.current_market_entries,0) AS current_market_entries,COALESCE(x.current_freshly_priced,0) AS current_freshly_priced,
         COALESCE(x.current_unpriced_entries,0) AS current_unpriced_entries,COALESCE(s.awaiting_official_settlement,0) AS awaiting_official_settlement,
         CASE WHEN s.oldest_pending_settlement_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE EXTRACT(epoch FROM c.at-s.oldest_pending_settlement_at)::bigint END AS oldest_pending_settlement_age_seconds,
         COALESCE(r.gross_realized_pnl,0)::numeric AS gross_realized_pnl,COALESCE(r.realized_fees,0)::numeric AS realized_fees,
         COALESCE(r.realized_pnl,0)::numeric AS realized_pnl,
         CASE WHEN COALESCE(x.current_market_entries,0)=0 THEN 0::numeric ELSE x.current_fresh_unrealized_pnl END::numeric AS current_fresh_unrealized_pnl,
         x.latest_mark_at,GREATEST(p.updated_at,COALESCE(f.last_fill_at,p.updated_at),COALESCE(r.last_realized_at,p.updated_at),
           COALESCE(x.latest_mark_at,p.updated_at)) AS last_updated,
         CASE WHEN p.config#>>'{raw,btc_realtime_paper,paper,starting_collateral_usd}'~'^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
              THEN (p.config#>>'{raw,btc_realtime_paper,paper,starting_collateral_usd}')::numeric END AS starting_collateral
  FROM selected_process p CROSS JOIN clock c LEFT JOIN fill_stats f USING(process_id) LEFT JOIN resolved_stats r USING(process_id)
  LEFT JOIN current_pnl x USING(process_id) LEFT JOIN pending_settlements s USING(process_id)
), presentation AS (
  SELECT *,CASE WHEN awaiting_official_settlement>0 OR current_unpriced_entries>0 THEN NULL::numeric
                ELSE realized_pnl+COALESCE(current_fresh_unrealized_pnl,0)::numeric END AS total_pnl FROM metrics
)
SELECT name AS "Process",left(process_id::text,8) AS "Process ID",status AS "Status",
       current_market_entries AS "Current Market Entries",awaiting_official_settlement AS "Awaiting Official Settlement",
       current_fresh_unrealized_pnl::double precision AS "Current Fresh Unrealized PnL",total_pnl::double precision AS "Total PnL",
       oldest_pending_settlement_age_seconds AS "Oldest Pending Settlement Age",current_freshly_priced AS "Freshly Priced Current Entries",
       current_unpriced_entries AS "Unpriced Current Entries",realized_pnl::double precision AS "Lifetime Net Realized PnL",
       gross_realized_pnl::double precision AS "Gross Realized PnL",realized_fees::double precision AS "Realized Fees",
       CASE WHEN starting_collateral>0 AND total_pnl IS NOT NULL THEN (total_pnl/starting_collateral)::double precision END AS "ROI",
       enabled AS "Enabled",heartbeat_at AS "Last Heartbeat",EXTRACT(epoch FROM now()-COALESCE(heartbeat_at,updated_at))::bigint AS "Heartbeat Age",
       last_updated AS "Last Updated",filled_orders AS "Filled Orders",resolved_positions AS "Resolved Positions"
FROM presentation ORDER BY last_updated DESC,name;

panels.description: Daily net realized PnL grouped by UTC realization day. Recognized manual live exits use their exit day and actual net proceeds; other filled entries use the official settlement day and economics.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS from_ts,$__timeTo()::timestamptz AS to_ts
), selected_process AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.process_id,p.name,p.created_at FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
  WHERE (${pnl_scope:sqlstring}='All processes' OR p.process_id=(${process_id:sqlstring})::uuid)
    AND p.process_type='btc_5m' AND p.process_scope='realtime_paper' AND p.status<>'completed'
), filled_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT o.process_id,o.order_id,o.market_id,o.token_id,SUM(f.size)::numeric AS filled_size,
         SUM(f.price*f.size)::numeric AS entry_cost,SUM(f.fee)::numeric AS entry_fees,MAX(f.timestamp_utc) AS filled_at,
         BOOL_AND(f.source='live') AS is_live
  FROM selected_process p JOIN polymarket.orders o USING(process_id)
  JOIN polymarket.fills f ON f.order_id=o.order_id AND f.process_id=o.process_id AND f.source IN ('paper','live')
  WHERE o.side='buy'
  GROUP BY o.process_id,o.order_id,o.market_id,o.token_id
), recognized_exits AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.process_id,e.order_id,x.timestamp_utc AS realized_at,x.price AS exit_price,x.size AS exit_size,
         (x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,net_proceeds}')::numeric AS net_proceeds
  FROM filled_orders e JOIN polymarket.account_trades x ON x.linked_order_id=e.order_id AND x.token_id=e.token_id
  WHERE e.is_live AND x.side='sell' AND x.applied_exit_size=x.size AND x.applied_exit_size=e.filled_size
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,kind}'='manual_live_full_exit'
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,process_id}'=e.process_id::text
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,order_id}'=e.order_id
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,net_proceeds}'~'^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
), realized AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.process_id,e.order_id,x.realized_at,(x.net_proceeds-e.entry_cost-e.entry_fees)::numeric AS net_pnl
  FROM filled_orders e JOIN recognized_exits x USING(process_id,order_id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.process_id,e.order_id,m.official_resolution_received_at,
    (CASE WHEN e.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN e.filled_size ELSE 0::numeric END-e.entry_cost-e.entry_fees)::numeric
  FROM filled_orders e JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id=e.market_id
  WHERE m.official_outcome IN ('up','down') AND m.official_winning_token_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recognized_exits x WHERE x.process_id=e.process_id AND x.order_id=e.order_id)
)
, ranged AS (SELECT r.* FROM realized r CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE r.realized_at BETWEEN b.from_ts AND b.to_ts)
, realized_by_day AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day',realized_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS utc_day,SUM(net_pnl)::numeric AS net_pnl FROM ranged GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT to_char(utc_day,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Day",net_pnl::double precision AS "Daily Net Realized PnL"
FROM realized_by_day ORDER BY utc_day;

panels.title: Daily Net Realized PnL

panels.description: Lifetime net realized PnL for every BTC five-minute realtime-paper process. Recognized manual live exits use actual net proceeds; other filled entries use official settlement economics.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eligible_processes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.process_id,p.name,p.created_at FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
  WHERE p.process_type='btc_5m' AND p.process_scope='realtime_paper' AND p.status<>'completed'
), selected_process AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM eligible_processes),
filled_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT o.process_id,o.order_id,o.market_id,o.token_id,SUM(f.size)::numeric AS filled_size,
         SUM(f.price*f.size)::numeric AS entry_cost,SUM(f.fee)::numeric AS entry_fees,MAX(f.timestamp_utc) AS filled_at,
         BOOL_AND(f.source='live') AS is_live
  FROM selected_process p JOIN polymarket.orders o USING(process_id)
  JOIN polymarket.fills f ON f.order_id=o.order_id AND f.process_id=o.process_id AND f.source IN ('paper','live')
  WHERE o.side='buy'
  GROUP BY o.process_id,o.order_id,o.market_id,o.token_id
), recognized_exits AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.process_id,e.order_id,x.timestamp_utc AS realized_at,x.price AS exit_price,x.size AS exit_size,
         (x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,net_proceeds}')::numeric AS net_proceeds
  FROM filled_orders e JOIN polymarket.account_trades x ON x.linked_order_id=e.order_id AND x.token_id=e.token_id
  WHERE e.is_live AND x.side='sell' AND x.applied_exit_size=x.size AND x.applied_exit_size=e.filled_size
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,kind}'='manual_live_full_exit'
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,process_id}'=e.process_id::text
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,order_id}'=e.order_id
    AND x.raw_payload#>>'{reconciliation,net_proceeds}'~'^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
), realized AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.process_id,e.order_id,x.realized_at,(x.net_proceeds-e.entry_cost-e.entry_fees)::numeric AS net_pnl
  FROM filled_orders e JOIN recognized_exits x USING(process_id,order_id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.process_id,e.order_id,m.official_resolution_received_at,
    (CASE WHEN e.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN e.filled_size ELSE 0::numeric END-e.entry_cost-e.entry_fees)::numeric
  FROM filled_orders e JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id=e.market_id
  WHERE m.official_outcome IN ('up','down') AND m.official_winning_token_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recognized_exits x WHERE x.process_id=e.process_id AND x.order_id=e.order_id)
), realized_by_process AS (
  SELECT process_id,SUM(net_pnl)::numeric AS net_pnl FROM realized GROUP BY process_id
)
SELECT p.name||' ['||left(p.process_id::text,8)||']' AS "Process",
       COALESCE(r.net_pnl,0::numeric)::double precision AS "Lifetime Net Realized PnL"
FROM eligible_processes p LEFT JOIN realized_by_process r USING(process_id)
ORDER BY COALESCE(r.net_pnl,0::numeric) DESC,p.created_at DESC,p.process_id;
